description: This Java class 'CacheController' is part of a Spring MVC web application. It handles HTTP requests related to cache management, including displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries within the admin interface of the application.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing cache operations in the admin section, including displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries.

methods.name: displayAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display cache keys for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Handles POST requests to clear a specific cache key or all cache entries for a merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu attributes in the model for UI display; used internally.
